top_signals.title: Larry Ellison Risk Exposed by Paramount and Oracle Debt Binges
top_signals.summary: As Paramount Skydance Corp. and Oracle Corp. vault into the ranks of corporate America’s biggest borrowers, their links to the same man — billionaire Larry Ellison — are starting to stir angst on Wall Street.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
